name: DBLP Computer Science Papers Downsampled Source-Schema Subset
description: Downsampled DBLP bibliographic records used as benchmark input for the papers web-data-integration usecase. The file preserves a DBLP XML-shaped source schema instead of the integrated schema. Rows are ordered like the schema-mapped DBLP subset so existing identity-resolution identifiers remain stable. Records are taken from the local DBLP XML dump.

variableMeasured.name: _type
variableMeasured.description: Original DBLP XML publication element name, such as article or inproceedings

variableMeasured.name: _attributes
variableMeasured.description: Attributes from the original DBLP XML element

variableMeasured.name: _doi_list
variableMeasured.description: DOIs extracted from DBLP doi, ee, or url fields for benchmark alignment

variableMeasured.name: author
variableMeasured.description: DBLP author value or list of author values

variableMeasured.name: booktitle
variableMeasured.description: DBLP booktitle or conference field where available

variableMeasured.name: number
variableMeasured.description: DBLP number or issue field where available

variableMeasured.name: pages
variableMeasured.description: DBLP page range field where available

variableMeasured.name: ee
variableMeasured.description: DBLP electronic edition link or list of links
